On this page

Viable Prompt Protocol is an open-source project published by Seb Suarez.

Get help ​

  • For installation, protocol, or runtime questions, open a GitHub issue.
  • For private support, security coordination, privacy questions, or terms questions, email contact@cbassuarez.com.
  • For implementation details, read the installation guide, VPP v1.5 specification, and validator documentation.

When reporting a problem, include the plugin or protocol version, host, relevant operation, and a minimal reproducible example. Remove API keys, authentication material, private transcripts, and other sensitive content before sharing logs or opening a public issue.

Service status checks ​

  • Runtime health: https://mcp.viableprompt.org/healthz
  • OpenAPI document: https://mcp.viableprompt.org/api/v1/openapi.json
  • Source repository: cbassuarez/viable-prompt-protocol

The MCP URL is https://mcp.viableprompt.org/mcp. It expects MCP requests and is not intended to render a browser page.

Policies ​

Review the privacy policy for data handling and retention, and the terms of service for permitted use and service limitations.
